question: What is an authored 3D medial skeleton + radius, how does 25×40 sample its canal, and why must yaw/gait write plants about M?
skeleton: 5 authored nodes like FACE_CANON. Never Voronoi the 512. MAT flickers.
sample: P(u,θ,v) = γ(u) + v r(u) n(θ) with n·γ' = −r'. Tilted characteristic, not offset tube.
chart: rings 0–16 torso/crown (ring 0 = FACE_CANON). rings 17–24 split L/R plant by sector. ring 24 glued to live 512 until E6. Meridians die at crotch.
yaw: X' = M + R_Y(θ)(X−M). Double support M = plant midpoint. Single support M = planted contact. Kill facingCompress about centroid. Kill z = ox·sin + z0·cos.
gait: Writes plants only AFTER bones exist. Then retire walkScaffoldZ-on-radius, stance-fold on 512, gaitFlattenRadiusDelta.
sources: Guo, Wang, Matusik, Medial Skeletal Diagram, TOG 2024
fix: none this pass. Dual + 3D sample spec + E1–E5 recs only.
